methodology.primary: PIT Piotroski + PIT Altman Z with decision-date USD FX normalization and LSE GBp-to-GBP scaling
methodology.exitGrid: Existing live hybrid simulator with research-only TP1 R, stop-cap, time-cap, and TP1-only injection; no exit logic is duplicated.
methodology.bh: Benjamini-Hochberg over every executed cell/variant, plus a separately corrected Part D Piotroski-threshold family.
methodology.pooledDevelopment: Non-overlapping, date-aligned development test windows pooled by calendar year; final fold remains separate holdout.
